name: session-walkthrough
description: Live, self-driven walkthrough tours of session changes in the already-running browser: an overlay highlights each changed element and quotes the request line it covers. Read-mostly; never approval, upload, save or Git authority.

interface.shortDescription: Walk users through session changes with a live in-browser tour.
interface.longDescription: Run a live, self-driven overlay tour of a session's changes in the already-running managed browser: each step highlights a changed element and quotes the request line it covers. The user clicks through it; the tour only sets controls and never saves.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through the changes from this session.
